dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast perimeters. A prominent 'O' shape in the central lateral field shows a sharp transition from a dark interior to a bright, discontinuous white ring. A chain of three semi-enclosed 'C' structures is visible along the upper-mid section with pixelated boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Dense clusters of localized high-intensity white pixels are concentrated in the posterior region. A thick, irregular longitudinal band of high-intensity pixels is located along the upper dorsal margin. Smaller, asymmetrical blobs of low-density white pixels are scattered in the anterior lateral zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest 'O' structures form a roughly obtuse triangle in the mid-lateral region. A series of four high-intensity blobs on the dorsal ridge forms a slightly curved linear sequence.

other_distinctive_markers: Interlocking and overlapping 'chain-link' texture formed by the proximity of multiple annuli.
